note: Its clock input; the module divides the clock for the rest of the rack. Jack not named.

Port name is the owner's wording ('main out'); the Digitakt manual is not ingested to check it.
THRU forwards the RD-9's stream unchanged (clock, transport, ch 10 notes), so the Analog Four is clocked by the RD-9 one hop earlier than the Thru5 synths.
OUT, not THRU: the Thru5 gets the Digitakt's own clock/transport (following the RD-9) plus its MIDI tracks. The RD-9's ch 10 notes stop at the Digitakt.
The owner: all Eurorack signals end up in the Intellijel outs, which send L and R balanced TRS to the interface.
Pairing comes from the makers' listings (the two are sold as a pair); the owner has not described the cable between them.
Shares one Thru5 output with the Donner B1: one or the other.
Owner 2026-09-23: reaches Logic Pro on the Mac Mini over the UMC1820's existing USB link. One Thru5 output is still free.
